purpose: Independently test whether contrast increase and decrease benefit from separate learning and localized damage features.
fit_source: Both R32 cohorts become training. Exact same 128 original/edited pairs and blinded visual judgments. No project acceptance or R33 image enters fit.

comparison.fixed_split: R32 hypothesis: protected_strong for increase, R15 20 for decrease
comparison.r32_frozen: R32 pooled model and original threshold
comparison.pool_refit: R32 feature family, one refitted pointwise model
comparison.split_global: two pointwise models, same R32 features
comparison.split_spatial: two pointwise models, with spatial and face features
comparison.split_pair: two same-request pairwise rankers, gated by split_spatial pointwise confidence

training: StandardScaler + L2 logistic C=.25; same original group excluded in every fit/validation fold. Every fitted method uses only out-of-group winner scores and no incomplete delivery in calibration. Thresholds and weights frozen before held outcomes.

gate.primary: Compare complete deliveries and newly introduced failed images against fixed_split. Include two-direction success by original group and separately count partial, failed, uncertain, appropriate defer, missed.
gate.guardrail: Even with an improvement this is a contrast-only diagnostic, not formal trial qualification.

review: Blind recipe order, Codex directly sees original, anonymous candidates, and one or more matched native crops. Complete requires requested direction visible and original named detail/colors preserved. No L1 and no language-model generation. Same candidate reused for aligned languages.
